newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police hunt missing Ethiopian soccer team.
newsitem.headline: Italian police hunt missing Ethiopian soccer team.

text.p: Italian police said on Wednesday they were looking for 16 members of Ethiopia's national soccer team who went missing in Rome before they were due to fly to Casablanca for an African National Cup match.
"They do not have residence permits and under Italian law they are here illegally. At the moment we do not know where they are," said a police official who declined to be identified.
On Tuesday, Ethiopian state radio reported that most of the team had disappeared while on a stopover in Rome.
The players arrived in Italy on Monday afternoon from Addis Ababa and were scheduled to fly to Casablanca on Tuesday.
Early on Tuesday morning 16 members, including the coach, left their hotel with their passports and their luggage, according the hotel manager.
Seven members of the original group were still in Rome. "We have questioned the seven people remaining here but they knew nothing about the others," the police official said.
